The jumbles (LSUG) are also unpronounceable, so no child would choose them, which leaves a two-way choice the cue then settles. Fix: make the not-a-word option a pronounceable non-word that is not an anagram of the key (in the house example, DRAP sits beside DRIP), or vary which options share letters with the key.
